title: Toward Holistic Evaluation of Recommender Systems Powered by Generative Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith/religion. It proposes a general framework for evaluating generative recommender systems and uses a hypothetical example of cultural norms (recommending alcohol to a user from a culture where it is discouraged) to illustrate potential issues of bias.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its main contribution is a conceptual framework for holistically evaluating generative recommender systems, highlighting challenges like bias and cultural insensitivity without conducting specific religious-themed experiments.
